faqs.q: What is DUSA and how does it help small businesses?
faqs.a: DUSA is an all-in-one growth platform that replaces the scattered tools small businesses use for CRM, email marketing, SMS, funnels, booking, and reputation management. Instead of paying for five or six separate subscriptions, everything lives in one connected system.

faqs.q: How much does the DUSA platform cost per month?
faqs.a: Plans start from {launchpad} {currency} per month for a single core tool on our Launchpad plan. Our Starter plan includes all 9 core systems for {starter}/mo, and Growth unlocks unlimited contacts, advanced automations, and priority support for {growth}/mo. All prices are in {currency} with no hidden fees.

faqs.q: What is included in the Launchpad plan?
faqs.a: Launchpad gives you access to one core system of your choice from nine options: CRM and pipeline, funnels and website, email marketing, SMS marketing, booking and calendar, social media planner, reputation management, invoicing and payments, or forms and surveys. It includes full dashboard access, basic analytics, AI chat support, and community access. It is designed for sole operators who want to start small and scale up.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade my plan at any time?
faqs.a: Yes. You can upgrade or change your plan at any time. Changes take effect on your next billing cycle. There are no lock-in contracts, and you can move between plans as your business needs change.

faqs.q: Are there any setup fees or hidden costs?
faqs.a: There are no setup fees on any plan. Your plan price covers platform access. Message, call, email and AI usage is billed separately as you use it, drawn from a prepaid balance in your account. Your card is charged a small top-up when you first switch those features on, and again automatically whenever the balance runs low. You set the top-up amount and can add balance yourself at any time. Usage is billed in USD because the telephony, email and AI providers behind the platform are US based. Most clients see around US$15-25 per month depending on volume. There are no other hidden fees.

faqs.q: What kind of support does DUSA offer?
faqs.a: Every plan includes unlimited AI chat support available 24/7 through your members portal, plus access to the DUSA community. Starter and above includes email support. Growth plans get priority support and an onboarding strategy session. Bespoke clients receive a dedicated account manager, phone support, and monthly strategy reviews.

faqs.q: Is DUSA suitable for sole operators and freelancers?
faqs.a: Absolutely. The DUSA platform was built for sole operators, freelancers, and small business owners who need professional tools without enterprise complexity. The Launchpad plan at {launchpad}/mo is specifically designed as a low-commitment entry point so you can try one tool and expand as you grow.

The DUSA community is a members-only space where business owners share strategies, ask questions, and get support from other DUSA users and the DUSA team. It is included with every plan and is a great resource for learning how to get the most out of the platform.

faqs.q: Does DUSA replace tools like Mailchimp, Calendly, and HubSpot?
faqs.a: Yes. DUSA includes email marketing (replacing Mailchimp), booking and scheduling (replacing Calendly), CRM and pipeline management (replacing HubSpot), plus SMS marketing, funnel and website building, social media planning, reputation management, invoicing, and forms. All in one platform for a fraction of the combined cost.

faqs.q: How long does it take to set up DUSA?
faqs.a: Most businesses are up and running within 48 hours. Our Launchpad plan can be live in under an hour. Growth and Bespoke plans include an onboarding strategy session where we help you configure everything for your specific business.
Yes. All DUSA pricing on this page is in {currency} ({regionLabel}). There are no currency conversions or surprises on your invoice.

home.metaDesc: Marketing, sales and customer engagement from one login. DUSA is the all-in-one growth platform for small businesses that want to scale without the complexity.
home.schemaDesc: All-in-one growth platform for small businesses. CRM, marketing automation, sales pipelines, and customer engagement from one login.

items.a: DUSA replaces the 10+ disconnected apps most businesses juggle with one platform. CRM, email, SMS, funnels, scheduling, payments, reviews, and AI automations, all under one login. Every lead gets chased, every booking gets confirmed, and every follow-up happens automatically.

Plans start at $149 per month. Most businesses we onboard are currently paying $800 to $1,100 per month across separate tools, so switching usually pays for itself several times over in the first month.

items.q: Do I need to be technical?
items.a: Not at all. We do the setup for you. Your CRM, automations, funnels, and integrations are configured by our team within the first week. If you can use email, you can run DUSA.

items.q: What happens to my existing contacts and tools?
items.a: We migrate everything. Contacts, campaigns, and data move across from your old tools as part of onboarding, and we train you and your team before you go live. Nothing gets lost in the switch.

items.q: Am I locked into a contract?
items.a: No. You can cancel anytime. We keep customers by being useful, not by locking the door.

items.q: How fast can I be up and running?
items.a: Your workspace is set up within days, and most businesses are fully live, with data migrated and team trained, inside two weeks.
AI support is available 24/7 on every plan, and real humans back it up. Growth and Bespoke plans also get a dedicated account manager who checks in on you proactively.
